deploy-bot: Production rollout starting for tag `release/2026-03-20-rc3` (commit `7f9c2b8`). Initiated by @alex. Strategy: staged canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with automated health checks. Change window: 2026-03-20 16:00-17:00 UTC. Services: inference-api, router, cache. Deploy id: deploy-8472. CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/8472 · Changelog: https://internal/releases/rc3
alex: Taking first watch, will ping if anything spikes. @oncall you're up for rotations?
maria: Quick Q — any DB migrations in this release?
deploy-bot: No schema or DB migrations. Config pins: `model-serving:v3.2.1-quant`. Canary hosts: `usw2-prod-canary-*`. Stage timeout: 10m. Auto-fallback policy enabled to previous model variant on error thresholds.
sam: I'll watch latency dashboards — Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/inference-latency
jin: If error rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive mins we should auto-rollback per policy, right?
deploy-bot: Correct — automated rollback threshold = 0.5% 5xx over 3m. Also will fall back to `model-serving:v3.2.0` if triggered.
oncall: :thumbsup: good to go, I'll handle incident paging if needed.
deploy-bot: Canary 5% started (deploy-8472) — 2026-03-20T16:04:12Z
maria: Canary logs look clean so far. No 5xx, a couple of client timeouts but within expectations.
alex: p50 steady, p95 +30ms but within SLO. No obvious tail latencies yet.
sam: Seeing a small increase in token throughput but CPU headroom fine.
deploy-bot: Canary health OK. Advancing to 25% — 2026-03-20T16:14:52Z
sam: 25% looks stable, no error trend.
maria: No spike in error budget, ramping sounds fine.
deploy-bot: 25% stable. Gradual rollout to 100% starting — 2026-03-20T16:29:03Z
maria: Monitoring channels are green. Will keep an eye on rerank latency.
alex: Noting: watch batch queue depth for the next 30m.
sam: Will alert if p95 > 1.2s or error rate rises.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% (deploy-8472). Production deploy finished successfully. Commit: `7f9c2b8`. Release tag: `release/2026-03-20-rc3`. Finished at 2026-03-20T16:40:21Z. Release notes: https://internal/releases/rc3
alex: Deployed. Minor follow-ups: keep an eye on batch queue and cache hit rate for 1h.
oncall: I'll stay on rotation until 17:00 UTC and escalate if anything pops.
sam: :party_parrot: nice ship!
jin: Marking config promoted: `prod -> release/2026-03-20-rc3` in deploy registry.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Notifying #incidents and closing this deploy thread. If any automated rollbacks occur, a new thread will be created.
